notes.title: Join Us for OTK games expo 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, citizens!
[/p][h2]We’re thrilled to announce that Roadside Egg Stand will be featured in this year’s OTK Games Expo 2025.
[/h2][p]As part of the event, we’ll be unveiling a brand-new trailer, and we can't wait for you to see what we’ve been cooking up.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477068/5f0ab14f624e046c82fd158d9aed9ec85f7857ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]📅 Mark your calendars: May 25th, 2025
[/p][p]We’re incredibly grateful to the OTK Games Expo team for including us in this year’s lineup.
[/p][h2]If you’re a fan of quirky adventures and charming worlds, don’t forget to check out Roadside Egg Stand — and add it to your wishlist!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430920/Roadside_Egg_Stand/"][/dynamiclink][/h2]
